description: Read, set, test or clear the webhook where a brand's alerts are POSTed the minute the cron writes them (owner/admin to change it). format json: body {event: brand.alerts, project, alerts[], radar_url}, header X-VH-Signature = sha256=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body with the secret returned here>; format discord or slack: a message for that channel's incoming webhook. Answer 2xx within 8 s; no retry (alerts stay readable). url null clears it. Guide: https://viralhunt.io/webhooks

format.description: What arrives: json = our signed body (an agent, n8n, Make, Zapier, a server); discord or slack = a message for that channel's incoming webhook (no code in between); auto (default) reads a Discord or Slack URL by itself. Only with url.

test.description: true = send ONE sample alert to the saved webhook now (action webhook_test) and report what the receiver answered (ok, code, hint). Run it right after setting a webhook.

url.description: https URL on a public host to set; null to clear; omit to read.

name: viralhunt_brand_webhook
